newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech finmin licences credit risk insurance firm.
newsitem.headline: Czech finmin licences credit risk insurance firm.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry said on Tuesday that it had granted a credit risk insurance licence to the Prague-based agency CESCOB Uverova Pojistovna a.s.
In a statement, the ministry said CESCOB's activity would be concentrated on issuing risk insurance for short-term credit to Czech entities and branches of foreign companies.
"It will not insure political risk or long-term credits," the ministry said, adding that no state subsidies were expected to be provided.
It said the activities would include purchasing information on debtors from specialised factoring companies and to sell that information to its clients and other firms.
Details on the ownership composition of CESCOB were not immediately available.
